details.description: Reimagine your scalp health with Meera Anti-Dandruff Shampoo, a transformative formula infused with the finest natural ingredients. Packed with the goodness of small onions and fenugreek, this shampoo tackles the four key problems of dandruff - white flakes, itchiness, dry scalp, and hair fall. The small onion extract works to combat dandruff, controlling unsightly white flakes and soothing irritation, while the nourishing fenugreek strengthens and conditions your hair for a healthy, vibrant look. Gentle enough for daily use, this herbal shampoo cleanses deeply while restoring the natural balance of your scalp, leaving your hair feeling fresh, fragrant, and revitalised. Experience the power of nature's remedies and say goodbye to dandruff worries with Meera Anti-Dandruff Shampoo.
details.usageInstructions:
Wet your hair and take sufficient amount of shampoo and mix it with water.
Pour it over your hair and keep it for at least 5 minutes.
Wash your hair thoroughly with water.

details.description: One of the flagship brands of CavinKare, Meera boasts of a portfolio of products stressing on wholesome health for hair. The brand derives its strengths from deep understanding of traditional Indian practices and giving it to consumers in easy-to-use contemporary formats. The brand 'MEERA' evokes immense respect from both consumers & retailers which only a few other brands can claim and is one of the household brands of South India. According to Ayurvedic literature, one of the causes of hair problems could be excess body heat. Cool your body with a weekly routine of oiling your hair before you take a bath with Meera Herbal Hairwash Powder. It is an aromatic blend of roots, flowers, and leaves from 11 natural herbs. It contains Shikakai, Green gram, Tulsi, Vetiver and Reetha that cleanses your hair and leaves it fresh and shiny, whilst hibiscus and fenugreek act as deep conditioners, strengthening each strand of hair from root to the tip. Meera takes its inspiration from tradition and brings the goodness of time-tested practices in a convenient form. The traditional routine of oil bath with Meera Herbal Hairwash Powder cools your body, strengthens and nourishes your hair from root to tip, giving you healthy and problem-free hair, naturally.
details.usageInstructions:
1. Cut open the pack and take required quantity of this powder into a bowl.
2. Mix it with water and make it into a paste.
3. Apply oil on head.
4. Leave it for few minutes.
5. Wet head, apply the paste on your head, massage for few minutes and rinse.
